caseName: A. B. Kirschbaum Co. v. Fleming
caseNameFull: A. B. Kirschbaum Co. v. Fleming, Administrator

opinions.text: L. Metcalfe Walling, present Administrator of the Wage and Hour Division, U. S. Dept, of Labor, substituted as the party respondent herein in the place and stead of Philip B. Fleming resigned.
